text: The NDC‑IMS upgrade integrates sectoral monitoring with national reporting, supports iterative updates of the NDC Implementation Plan, and aligns with new quantitative adaptation targets. It features deep integration with AFOLU/REDD+ MRV and land-use governance, and coordination via the Regional Pacific NDC Hub for targeted technical assistance. The system tracks indicators such as renewable energy generation, land-use emissions, and adaptation metrics across agriculture, health, and transport sectors.

metadata.solution_name: Nationally Determined Contribution Information Management System Upgrade (NDC‑IMS upgrade)
